description: This source file implements a priority queue (heap-based) data structure and associated operations for managing 'pq_entry' objects, including insertion, removal, and cleanup functions.

methods.name: int pq_less(struct pq_entry * a,struct pq_entry * b)
methods.description: Compares two pq_entry structures based on their record comparison and index to determine ordering in the priority queue.

methods.name: int merged_iter_pqueue_remove(struct merged_iter_pqueue * pq,struct pq_entry * out)
methods.description: Removes the top element from the priority queue heap, maintains heap property, and optionally outputs the removed entry.

methods.name: int merged_iter_pqueue_add(struct merged_iter_pqueue * pq,const struct pq_entry * e)
methods.description: Adds a new entry to the priority queue heap, maintaining the heap property.

methods.name: void merged_iter_pqueue_release(struct merged_iter_pqueue * pq)
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the priority queue and resets its state.
